notes.title: Monster Portal! – Big Gameplay Overhaul! Just in time for the Steam Summer Sale
notes.content:
[h2][b]Monster Portal – Major Patch Update![/b] 🌀[/h2][p][b]New Features, Performance Improvements, and Huge Balancing Overhaul!

[/b]📢 Ready to dive back in?[/p][p]With all-new balance, smoother game-play, and clearer UI — this update makes [i]Monster Portal[/i] better than ever.[b]
[/b][/p][hr][/hr][h3]
🔥 [b]NEW & IMPROVED FEATURES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]🧭 [b]Mini Map Added![/b]
See shops, portals, quests, health regen zones, and bosses at a glance.[/p][/*][*][p]💠 [b]Gem Store Upgrade![/b]
Make your gold matter with powerful gem upgrades and a cleaner buying/selling experience.[/p][/*][*][p]🚨 [b]Danger Indicators[/b]
Now you'll [i]know[/i] what hurts — new danger icons alert you to threats.[/p][/*][*][p]🎯 [b]Ultimate Abilities Rebalanced[/b]
Stronger ultimates, smoother gameplay, bigger impact![/p][/*][*][p]🧼 [b]Improved Help Menu & Color-Coded Hints[/b]
Understand everything faster with better tool-tips and clearer guidance.
[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]
⚔️ [b]BOSS + ENEMY UPDATES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]🧠 [b]Boss AI Overhaul[/b]
Bosses and minibosses no longer get stuck on the player — there's always a way out![/p][/*][*][p]💥 [b]Boss Fights Revamped[/b]
Major improvements to Boss 1, Boss 2, and Boss 4 (including projectile defenses and shield interactions).[/p][/*][*][p]👿 [b]Miniboss Attack Variants[/b]
Minibosses now use alternate attack patterns on levels 2, 3, and 4.[/p][/*][*][p]😵 [b]Improved Enemy Status Effects[/b]
Buffed [i]Eye Stun[/i], new [b]stun/poison particles[/b], and visible player effect icons (stun, buff, poisoned, etc.).
[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]
🎮 [b]GAMEPLAY & BALANCE CHANGES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]💨 [b]Sprint & Dodge Reworks[/b][/p][list][*][p]Sprint now respects slow debuffs[/p][/*][*][p]Dodge now moves through objects to help escape sticky situations and buildings[/p][/*][*][p]Shift = Sprint / Space = Dodge[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]💰 [b]Gold & Gem Economy Rebalance[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduced gem drops from minibosses to make gold buying at the shop more integral[/p][/*][*][p]Lower shop gem chance = more value for gold[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]🧙 [b]Path Buffs & Debuffs[/b][/p][list][*][p]🛡️ [i]Path of Death Eater[/i] buffed to +15 hit-points gained per kill [/p][/*][*][p]🐉 [i]Dragon & Veteran Paths[/i] fixed[/p][/*][*][p]👟 [i]Debuff Shoes[/i] scale by level (10% base + 5%/lvl)[/p][/*][*][p]🎭 [i]Level 3 Hooded Demon[/i] slightly nerfed[/p][/*][*][p]⚡ [i]Miniboss speed[/i] reduced on levels 4 & 5[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]🩸 [b]Health & Shield Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p]Health gem auto-give takes longer (balanced)[/p][/*][*][p]Shield gem duration slightly reduced[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]🚶 [b]Easy Mode Enhanced[/b][/p][list][*][p]Slower enemy cooldowns, slower projectiles, increased spawn time between monsters[/p][/*][*][p]"Made easy... even easier"
[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]
🎨 [b]VISUAL & AUDIO UPDATES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]🌪️ New screen shake effects for certain attacks[/p][/*][*][p]🔥 New particle effects for enemies, flamethrower, Boots of Haste, stunned/poisoned states[/p][/*][*][p]🎵 New sound effects for spike hits and dodge shots[/p][/*][*][p]🛍️ New Steam Store + Library art
[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]
🐞 [b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]✅ Fixed: Health regen upgrade now improves negative regen until positive (aka -1 will not go to -1.15 if upgraded, will now go to -1 -> -0.85 etc)[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Fixed: Gambler & Greedy Path bugs [/p][/*][*][p]✅ Fixed: Massive lag caused by 3rd boss[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Fixed: Totem speed bug with loot boss shots[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Fixed: Store logic issues and clarity[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Fixed: Text display after boss fights[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Fixed: Incorrect speed values in character select[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Fixed: Damage passing through Boss 4’s shields[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Fixed: "R" not opening the store reliably[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Fixed: Multiple shop UI bugs and text clipping[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Fixed: Boost of Haste logic bug
[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]
✨ [b]Other Quality of Life[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Higher shop appearance rate[/p][/*][*][p]Updated tutorial [/p][/*][*][p]Giving better hints and objectives when finding travelers notebook[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced snowflake opacity[/p][/*][*][p]Improved visual cues for [b]Confuse[/b] effect[/p][/*][*][p]Dodge Bomb added + shots & distance rework[/p][/*][*][p]Slight increase in Fire-shot refresh rate
[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]
[/h3]

notes.title: Game mechanics update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It was an awesome launch and I continue to make the game even better with more feedback! Here are some updates below, and I am hoping to implement steam leader-boards soon so that it can be more competitive with other players since this is a solo player game.

[b]
Game mechanics update![/b]

[list]
[*] Game now pauses when pressing [TAB] so you can take the time arranging your gems and reading about their spells/abilities, not having to worry about the chaos going on around you.
[*] Updated the tutorial and GUI to help inform the player more on the mechanics of the game.
[*] Added some new features to hopefully help the player understand how to bring out the bosses. 
[*] Further balanced monsters.
[*] Added some lighting effects
[/list]

notes.title: Major update for "Monster Portal" before planned release in February 2025!
notes.content:
[h1]Major update! [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882616/87854d37d672d076528c000996499a0b209a7d18.png[/img]

[list]

[h2]Major changes [/h2]

[*] Each hero now has his own ultimate ability
[*] Added 2 loot bosses that randomly spawn
[*] Game play paths are now unlock-able through various tasks ("Way of the X")
[*] Created a Chaos Totem with random positive/negative effects chosen at random if accepted
[*] Added an instance where magical "fairies" spawn and if you catch enough you level up 
[*] Toggle on/off new gem refresh rates (quick reference GUI)
[*] New gem info window when hovering over gems
[*] No cap for gem/player leveling anymore
[*] Gems are now named

notes.title: Little Big Monsters Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

I have been working a lot on the overall mechanics of the game! 

~ NEW ~

[list]
[*] You now receive 3 options when you level that you can choose to upgrade. They range from gem upgrades for every gem, leveling aspects of your given character (like speed, sprint duration, health, health regeneration, etc), or receiving 1 random gem!

[*] This really adds a lot of dynamic game-play and increases the depth of your character depending on the base path you take when choosing your character before each game!

[*] There is new music, updated particle effects, and much more! 

[*] Monsters now slightly increase as you level to balance the game and the base speed of everything has increased. 

[*] I have updated the main splash screen and character select screen as well.

[*] There are also numerous bug fixes and code optimizations!
[/list]

Please feel free to play and let me know what you think! Any bug fixes you report or ideas you have would be great to hear! It has been fun continuing the work on this game and I am not done yet!

Thank You!

notes.title: 75% off Little Big Monsters - Steam Summer Sale!!!
notes.content:
It is that time of the year again! A perfect time to pick up your copy of [b]Little Big Monsters[/b]!!!

A bunch of added new content in game!

[b]-Gameplay-[/b]
[list][/list]
[list]
[*] 5 new gems with new abilities including 2nd tier additions!

[olist]

       [*] Magic Orbs
       [*] AOE Electric Field
       [*] Ray Beam
       [*] Void Blast
[/olist]
    [*] 1 new enemy!
    [*] Updated a lot of ability particle effects
    [*] Single sword attack can now attack in all directions
    [*] 30% global move increase
    [*] Boots went from 100%/50% increase to 50%/25% because of overall global speed boost update.
    [*] Health/Mana gems auto give pots every 30 seconds (no more clicking to place on ground and you can also add them to the passive gem slot)
[/list]

[b]-General-[/b]
[list]
    [*] New music!
    [*] New sound effects!
    [*] Updated menu screens
    [*] Fixed numerous bugs
    [*] Gems that you used on your run now show up on death screen
    [*] More settings
    [*] Fixed Lag issues
[/list]

[b]-Brainstorming things to come-[/b]
[list]
    [*] Every character level up could have a choice between 3 things to make your character/gems better
    [*] Maybe every 5 levels get a divine choice (ex-2% dmg, % exp to gems, free level, permanent speed increase, increase health/mana regeneration, increase overall health or mana, shield?, 20% discount at gem stores)
    [*] Create more gems
    [*] Create more enemies
    [*] Mouse scale option
    [*] More dynamic AI fights
    [*] Randomly created caves/camps with loot/enemies/mini bosses
    [*] More setting options
[/list]

[b]-Brainstorming new paths-[/b]
[list]
    [*] [u]Way of the Divine[/u] – (Pro) You have 2 lives / (Con) Game must be played on hard
    [*] [u]Way of the Power[/u] – (Pro) Infinite mana / (Con) All gems will stay at 1st tier
    [*] [u]Way of the Chosen One[/u] – (Pro) All gems are 2nd tier / (Con) all monsters are %30 faster
    [*] [u]Way of the Dark Lord[/u] – (Pro) Double health and mana, double the regeneration rates / (Con) No
    lights anywhere except small one around you, and game must be played on hard
    [*] [u]Way of the Wicked[/u] - (Pro) All enemies constantly lose small portion of health / (Con) No gem store will ever show up on maps
[/list]
